nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 凌晨五点半，手机在枕头边疯狂震动。是 Ruby 发来的第七条语音。

nodes.speaker: Ruby
nodes.text: Wakey wakey!! The sunrise waits for NO ONE. I'm outside in ten, hey!

nodes.speaker: Ruby
nodes.text: Exactly! We're already late! Grab a jumper, it gets chilly by the water. Chop chop!

nodes.speaker: Ruby
nodes.text: That's the spirit!! Knew I picked the right person to drag out of bed.

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 圣基尔达海滩的清晨安静得出奇。天边刚泛起一线橘红，Ruby 把两块冲浪板插在沙滩上。

nodes.speaker: Ruby
nodes.text: Look at that. Heaps good, right? This is my favourite classroom.

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 她忽然噤声，指向防波堤的岩石缝——那里卡着一只小企鹅，正笨拙地扑腾。

nodes.speaker: Ruby
nodes.text: Oh no. Stay low and quiet, okay? It's a little penguin - he's stuck between the rocks.

nodes.speaker: Ruby
nodes.text: Hold my board and block the wind, just like that. I'll do the rest. Slowly... slowly...

nodes.speaker: Ruby
nodes.text: Good instinct! But the rescue team needs forty minutes, and the tide won't wait. We've got this - hold my board.

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: Ruby 半跪在湿滑的岩石上，双手稳得不可思议。三分钟后，小企鹅扑通一声滑回了海里。

nodes.speaker: Ruby
nodes.text: And off he goes! Did you see that little waddle? Best. Morning. Ever.

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 她坐回沙滩上，头发上还挂着海水，笑得比初升的太阳还亮。

nodes.speaker: Ruby
nodes.text: You know why I study marine bio? Moments like this. The ocean gives you a gift every single day, you just have to show up.

nodes.speaker: Ruby
nodes.text: Next arvo I'm teaching you to surf, no excuses. Deal?

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 回程的电车上，你的鞋里全是沙子，心里却装着一整片被朝阳染红的海。

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 【获得 100 金币】墨尔本的故事，从一只小企鹅开始。
